groups: TF01
Import and annotation keys; no runtime import performed.
TF02

Repair closure: inclusive through bisect_right, inclusive from_epoch(start) bisect_left bounded by frozen right, Decimal(level), direction strict low/high query, absent result None else to_epoch; no replacement/catch.
TF03
BasicRepeat holds latest mutable row and independent repair, verdict and base counters.
TF04
S rank=(priority(color),0); E rank=(priority(family),number); lifecycle priority normalizes labels and orders S blue, E blue, S red, E red.
TF05
Descending reference ranks strictly smaller than current; bisect_left normalized price excludes equality, previous entry yields latest crossed verdict; otherwise None.
TF06
Fresh repeat/reference state, direction policy; nested repair calls optional callback only if repair key absent, stores only non-null result.
TF07
Nonbasic event clears references, resets started and each verdict/base counter, retains latest/repair count; continue.
TF08
Start only on S; skip E before S; lower rank set, exact Decimal and bullish copy_negate; engulf if lower base>=2, display restart if lower verdict>=2.
TF09
S or engulf => T; otherwise reference T => F, reference other => T, absent => odd E F/even T. Store verdict; remove history tail >= normalized price and append current reference.
TF10

Pop all lower repeats; repair a lower single F from current time. Same rank/same verdict increments repair count; verdict count increments unless display restart and >=2 marks previous/current repeated. F removes old repair >= current time and repairs current. Base count increments for any previous same rank irrespective of verdict.
TF11
StopAll series initialization; new group on first or nonincreasing number; update prior end and max end; clear prefix and restart. Otherwise restart changes parity origin; update previous number.
TF12

Parity T on even offset; prefix accumulates while number <= largest prior end. At prior-end or max-end, absent/true confirmation callback qualifies; recompute prefix parity from group start and mark repeated, set restart; prefix retained until new series.
TF13
Primary side chosen by bullish else bearish. Clear three annotations on every row; include if calculationValid is not False; first wins by sourceTime in primary/StopAll/E/S order; sort by sourceTime.
TF14
Neutral default; primary flushes and clears StopAll group, assigns T for 1 and F for 2/3 only; collect StopAll; basic verdict then final StopAll. Mutate row references, no trading geometry changes.
